parts.text:
*[Sound effects: A soft, electronic chime. The subtle hum of a retinal HUD booting up. The heavy breathing of the armed men moving closer.]*

Just as my thumb tightens on the detonator, my encrypted comms unit vibrates against my ribs. A delayed decryption sequence from my anonymous source has finally cracked. The data flashes across the inside of my retina display in stark, green text:

**Block A: GHB: 10mg/mL (incomplete data packet)**
**Block B: Rohypnol: 1mg (incomplete data packet)**

Ice water floods my veins as the realization hits me. *Eclipse* isn't a recreational street drug. It’s a weaponized, highly concentrated cocktail of heavy sedatives and amnesiacs. A chemical black bag. No wonder the councilman and the CEO vanished without a trace—they didn't fight back because they were unconscious, their short-term memories completely wiped. 

This isn't a drug ring. It's an abduction syndicate. 

I need answers, and I can't interrogate corpses. A head-on firefight against three assault rifles is suicide anyway. Rafters it is.

I press the button.

*[Sound effects: A high-pitched, agonizing whine followed by an ear-splitting BANG. A blinding flash of magnesium-white light illuminates the warehouse. Shouts of pain, confusion, and the clatter of a dropped rifle.]*

"Argh! My eyes! Blind fire, light her up!" the leader screams, his voice-modulator glitching violently. 

*[Sound effects: Deafening, chaotic bursts of automatic gunfire tearing through wooden crates and ricocheting off concrete.]*

I don't hesitate. As the flashbang detonates, I launch myself off the rotting crates. My boots scramble against a steel support pillar, muscles burning as I haul myself upward. I swing my legs over the edge of a rusted catwalk twenty feet above the warehouse floor, melting instantly back into the shadows just as their vision starts to clear. 

Below me, the three men are scattered. Two are sweeping the floor with their rifle lasers, still blinking away the afterimage of the blast. The leader is standing near the center, rubbing his eyes, his gun held loosely in one hand. 

I draw a specialized, non-lethal shock-dart from my belt and load it into my sidearm. 

*[Sound effects: The faint, metallic click of a weapon locking onto a target.]*

I aim squarely at the back of the leader's neck. If I take him down quietly, I can use the zip-ties in my coat to string him up here in the rafters before his goons even know he's missing. Then, I can ask him exactly who is brewing this GHB/Rohypnol nightmare, and where the bodies are going.

*Do I take the shot and try to hoist him up quietly, or do I drop a smoke grenade to separate him from his crew first?*
